description: Live list of open alert issues, like Issues & Activity, filtered by policy and acknowledgement state.

configuration.name: accountIds
configuration.title: Account IDs
configuration.description: Comma-separated account IDs (e.g. 1234567,7654321). Accepts a dashboard variable, e.g. {{accounts}}.

configuration.name: policyNames
configuration.title: Policy names
configuration.description: Comma-separated policy names to include (exact, case-insensitive). Leave blank for all policies. Accepts a dashboard variable, e.g. {{policies}}.

configuration.name: unacknowledgedOnly
configuration.title: Unacknowledged only
configuration.description: Hide issues that have been acknowledged
